entries.subject: DAMIT 1830: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-1830.txt. Model 1830, version 2017-06-13, pole (55°, 11°), period 7.226189 h match the retained metadata. The archive diameter field is 198 ±4 km; its applicability to our scale is a separate calibration decision. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: Shape and spin alternatives
entries.finding: [Alternative pole and calibrated 203 km model.](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/asteroid_models/view/1831) — excluded alternative solution. One paired shape/pole solution is shown; no averaging or claim of a unique pole. Its alternative is documented. The live DAMIT export lists these other models for this target: 302: pole (58°, 16°), 7.226191 h, version 2011-02-19; 303: pole (242°, 4°), 7.22619 h, version 2011-02-19; 1831: pole (244°, 0°), 7.226189 h, version 2017-06-13, archive diameter 203 km. These are archive alternatives, not necessarily newly released models or preferred replacements. Comparing their source methods and any pole-specific calibration remains necessary before changing the selected mesh.
entries.revisitWhen: A released numerical replacement or independent pole/size constraints that distinguish the recorded alternatives, followed by comparison against the currently selected model.
